description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 93, Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003, Special Direction under Section 10 (1) (b) (ii)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a special direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003, establishing regulatory requirements for bread weights and labeling. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories.
